data.narrative:
Grain Weevil is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chad and Ben Johnson that has raised $3.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

The stage-progression method is applicable and yields a $9M implied valuation, using a 2.5x multiplier applied to the $4M total-raised proxy to model the typical step-up from Seed to next-stage financing. The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient narrow peer coverage; while 11 same-sector peers exist, only 1 same-stage and 1 adjacent-stage comparable were identified, falling short of the 3+ datapoint threshold needed for reliable median triangulation across comparable size and stage buckets.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7M (low) to $10M (high), with a median of $9M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around fair value given the constraint of only one triangulation approach. Key risks to valuation include the limited comparability of identified peers in stage and scale, and the inherent volatility of seed-stage robotics valuations. Additional data on recent funding rounds in the narrow peer set or expansion of the comparable universe would strengthen conviction in this range.
